options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: audit_comment
options.description: Add an audit comment to the rule being defined. This is only applied if there was a change to the rule.

options.name: description
options.description: The description.

options.name: destination_addresses
options.description: Destination addresses. When referencing predefined EDLs, use config names of the EDLS not their full names. The config names can be found with the CLI... request system external-list show type predefined-ip name <tab> panw-bulletproof-ip-list   panw-bulletproof-ip-list panw-highrisk-ip-list      panw-highrisk-ip-list panw-known-ip-list         panw-known-ip-list panw-torexit-ip-list       panw-torexit-ip-list

options.name: destination_dynamic_translated_address
options.description: For PAN-OS 8.1 and above. Dynamic destination translated address.

options.name: destination_dynamic_translated_distribution
options.description: For PAN-OS 8.1 and above. Dynamic destination translated distribution.

options.name: destination_dynamic_translated_port
options.description: For PAN-OS 8.1 and above. Dynamic destination translated port.

options.name: destination_translated_address
options.description: Static translated destination IP address.

options.name: destination_translated_port
options.description: Static translated destination port number.

options.name: device_group
options.description: (Panorama only) The device group the operation should target.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Rule is disabled or not.

options.name: existing_rule
options.description: If I(location=before) or I(location=after), this option specifies an existing rule name.  The rule being managed by this module will be positioned relative to the value of this parameter. Required if I(location=before) or I(location=after).

options.name: from_zones
options.description: From zones.

options.name: gathered_filter
options.description: When I(state=gathered). An advanced filtering option to filter results returned from PAN-OS. Refer to the guide discussing I(gathered_filter) for more information.

options.name: group_tag
options.description: For PAN-OS 9.0 and above. The group tag.

options.name: ha_binding
options.description: Device binding configuration in HA Active-Active mode.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: location
options.description: Position to place the rule in.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the rule.

options.name: nat_type
options.description: Type of NAT.

options.name: negate_target
options.description: Applicable for Panorama only. Negate the value for I(target).

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: rulebase
options.description: The rulebase in which the rule is to exist.  If left unspecified, this defaults to I(rulebase=pre-rulebase) for Panorama.  For NGFW, this is always set to be I(rulebase=rulebase).

options.name: service
options.description: The service.

options.name: source_addresses
options.description: Source addresses. When referencing predefined EDLs, use config names of the EDLS not their full names. The config names can be found with the CLI... request system external-list show type predefined-ip name <tab> panw-bulletproof-ip-list   panw-bulletproof-ip-list panw-highrisk-ip-list      panw-highrisk-ip-list panw-known-ip-list         panw-known-ip-list panw-torexit-ip-list       panw-torexit-ip-list

options.name: source_translation_address_type
options.description: For I(source_translation_type=dynamic-ip-and-port) or or I(source_translation_type=dynamic-ip). Address type.

options.name: source_translation_fallback_interface
options.description: For I(source_translation_fallback_type=interface-address). The interface for the fallback source translation.

options.name: source_translation_fallback_ip_address
options.description: For I(source_translation_fallback_type=interface-address). The IP address of the fallback source translation.

options.name: source_translation_fallback_ip_type
options.description: For I(source_translation_fallback_type=interface-address). The type of the IP address for the fallback source translation IP address.

options.name: source_translation_fallback_translated_addresses
options.description: For I(source_translation_fallback_type=translated-address). Addresses for translated address types of fallback source translation.

options.name: source_translation_fallback_type
options.description: For I(source_translation_type=dynamic-ip). Type of fallback for dynamic IP source translation.

options.name: source_translation_interface
options.description: For I(source_translation_address_type=interface-address). Interface of the source address.

options.name: source_translation_ip_address
options.description: For I(source_translation_address_type=interface-address). IP address of the source address translation.

options.name: source_translation_static_bi_directional
options.description: For I(source_translation_type=static-ip). Allow reverse translation from translated address to original address.

options.name: source_translation_static_translated_address
options.description: For I(source_translation_type=static-ip). The IP address for the static source translation.

options.name: source_translation_translated_addresses
options.description: For I(source_translation_address_type=translated-address). Translated addresses of the source address translation.

options.name: source_translation_type
options.description: Type of source address translation.

options.name: state
options.description: The state.

options.name: tags
options.description: Administrative tags.

options.name: target
options.description: Applicable for Panorama only. Apply this rule exclusively to the listed firewall serial numbers.

options.name: to_interface
options.description: Egress interface from route lookup.

options.name: to_zones
options.description: To zones. Note that there should only be one element in this list.

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: uuid
options.description: The rule UUID. Note that this is currently more of a read-only field. Usage of the UUID cannot currently take the place of using the rule name as the primary identifier.

options.name: vsys
options.description: The vsys this object belongs to.
